# `company.bill_payment_discounts`

Immutable early-payment discounts a bill payment took, one per settlement edge.

Database: `company`.

| Column | SQL type | Nullable | Default | Key | Indexes | References | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `id` | VARCHAR(26) | no | — | primary key 1 | ix_bill_payment_discounts_bill, ix_bill_payment_discounts_payment | — | Stable ULID of this discount. |
| `transaction_id` | VARCHAR(26) | no | — | — | ix_bill_payment_discounts_payment | ap_source_components.transaction_id, posting_line_sources.transaction_id, transaction_revisions.transaction_id | Bill payment that took the discount. |

| `source_component_id` | VARCHAR(26) | no | — | — | — | ap_source_components.id | Source component whose capacity carries the discount. |
| `application_id` | VARCHAR(26) | no | — | unique | — | ap_applications.id | Settlement edge the discount was taken on; its amount is cash plus discount. |

| `discount_account_id` | VARCHAR(26) | no | — | — | — | accounts.id | Account credited for the discount. |
| `posting_source_id` | VARCHAR(26) | no | — | — | — | posting_line_sources.id | Exact attribution row of the discount credit. |

| `created_at` | VARCHAR(32) | no | — | — | — | — | UTC time this discount was recorded. |
